reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in his DM: keep Tuesday 10 November at 15:30 free for the Marrow Fieldworks/Brindle rollout call.

That comes from what Hollis told me himself in an earlier DM: it's a standing Tuesday 15:30 call, starting from 14 October 2026. There's no calendar event for it, so I suggested he add one.

One thing doesn't add up: 14 October 2026 was a Wednesday, not a Tuesday. That doesn't change next week's date, but it may be worth confirming with him.
